{{Top}}
{{Quote|I say, Madam Director, I will accept that drink you offered and raise a toast to victory.|Fliry Vorru to Ysanne Isard|<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
[[File:A_toast_for_Soontir_Fel.png|thumb|Soontir Fel's father proposing a toast to his son]]
A '''toast''' was a social custom that involved the use of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]]. It consisted in a call to a gathering of beings to raise their beverages and drink together in honor of an event or person.<ref name="DADS">{{StoryCite|story=The Day after the Death Star!|book=Star Wars Weekly 97}}</ref> The toasters would usually clink their glasses<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> and drain them at a draught.<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> Toasts came often and exhuberantly in parties, dinner, and other times of merry-making. The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces, a celebration was held following the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]], and many toasts were drunk in honor of the victory against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DADS" />

Many [[Species/Legends|species]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] respected this tradition, including the [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="DADS" /> [[Half-Bothan]]s,<ref name="JVS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> [[Caridan (species)|Caridans]],<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassans]],<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="HG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>

Despite their rigid and ascetic lifestyle, the ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were familiar with this social ritual. On the brink of the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], the [[Half-Bothan]] [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] opened a barrel of his finest [[Wine/Legends|wine]]. He toasted in the company of his [[Farfalla's Knights|soldiers]], commenting on how they would first spill wine before spilling [[Blood/Legends|blood]] on the battlefield.<ref name="JVS" />

Members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] culture were also known to make toasts. [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] toasted the latest [[Hunter (individual)|victor]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] aboard his [[Spirit of Vengeance|ship]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] made a toast to their [[BL-series Battle Legionnaire|Battle Legionnaire]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] comrades and their hopes of victory prior to the [[Battle of New Bornalex]].<ref name="TNEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Other Mandalorians, such as [[Kal Skirata]], were known to toast to hopeful future prospects, as well as to the memories of lost loved ones,<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> and it was common practice to toast the [[Verd'goten|coming of age]] of a Mandalorian youth.<ref name="APM">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>

Sometimes, toasting was used ironically, as a way of mocking or even insulting someone. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], the [[Caridan (species)|Caridan]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Furgan]]&mdash;who was loyal to the defunct Empire&mdash;called a toast "in honor" of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|President]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and hurled his drink into her face. The glass was in fact full of a [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that seeped into Mon Mothma's pores and attacked her cells.<ref name="JS" />
